title: LR save link return location for AArch64
summary: Standard calls use X30 as the link register. A leaf function can return directly through LR without saving the return address to memory.
applies: AArch64; general call and register representation of AAPCS64
detail: Before making nested calls, the function that needs to return must save its return position in some way.
boundary: The specific preface is related to the deployment requirements and optimization strategies of the platform; whether there is a fixed frame record needs to be checked against the actual construction.
relevance: Understand why the stack slot holding the LR may not be visible when reading the normal ARM call chain.
